chosen_direction: Curtain-threshold waiting invitation after an opera encore
who: An explicitly adult woman with reference-derived visible face and bob; contained playful attention.

how: The camera is placed as an arriving adult companion at conversational distance and is acknowledged through eyes and hand.
why_now: She holds the threshold moment before approach, with the curtain open and the invitation already visible.

sir.individuality: Observed face/hair retained, with restrained expression rather than invented biography.
sir.relationship: A consistent same-person gaze, beckon and returning head address the camera-viewer.

reference_observations.observed: Short dark chin-length bob with airy forehead strands; dark eyes, softly arched brows, facial proportions and small visible cheek mark.

controls.prominence_goal: Seductive relationship leads the entire photograph; neither exposure amount nor actual desire is a metric.
